samples.summary: The only test guarding the anonymous-share security boundary ("Esc must stay inert for a share-link viewer") asserts nothing about behavior — just `not.toThrow()`
samples.evidence: The security-relevant property this change relies on is that the token-bearing, possibly-unauthenticated share mount (`packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:766`, which renders `<ImageViewer documentId={...} token={token} />` with no `onClose`) never navigates an anonymous viewer into the authenticated app shell. The test named for that property (`image-viewer.test.tsx:64-67`) only asserts `expect(() => fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "Escape" })).not.toThrow()`. No navigation spy, no `onClose` spy, no assertion on the router location. If a later change gave `ImageViewer` a `token`-independent default close (e.g. `onClose ?? (() => navigate(documentsPath))`), the anonymous share viewer would start firing `fetchWorkspaces`/navigating to `/w/:slug` — a 401-and-login-redirect path for an anonymous user — and this test would still pass, since the guarantee it names is not the guarantee it checks. Note the enforced lanes explicitly do not verify that a passing test asserts anything, so nothing else in the pipeline covers this boundary. No exploitable issue exists today: `onClose` is genuinely omitted at the share mount and `ImageViewer`'s sibling queries are already `enabled: !token` (image-viewer.tsx:70, 85).
searchedFor: Grep 'ImageViewer' across the repo — only two mounts: file-detail.tsx:152 (authenticated, passes onClose) and shared-document.tsx:766 (token, no onClose)
Grep 'FileShell|useDocumentsPath' across packages/frontend/src — hook reached only from the auth-gated /f/:id route (App.tsx:127 → FileDetail, which gates on fetchMe at file-detail.tsx:230)
Read shared-document.tsx SharedBlobLayout to confirm the anonymous path passes no onClose and renders no SiteHeader/leading slot
Read image-viewer.tsx keydown handler to confirm Escape is gated on `onClose` truthiness (line 126)
Read api/files.ts fileUrl and api/workspaces.ts fetchWorkspaces for token/parameter handling (token is encodeURIComponent'd, documentId passes through seg())

Read backend workspace.dto.ts SLUG_PATTERN and workspace.service.ts generateSlug to rule out an open redirect via navigate(`/w/${slug}`) — slugs are constrained to [a-z0-9-] with no leading hyphen/slash
